name: MailCrab Self-Hosted Email Test Server
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed SMTP capture and email inspection server with Web UI, JSON API and WebSocket updates; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Self-host via Docker, binary or Kubernetes and supply your own compute. Emails are stored in memory and lost on restart; default accept-all SMTP and permissive test authentication are unsuitable for public production mail delivery. Retention and high-volume WebSocket queue limits require configuration.
